logical_mapping_facts.enter: Assigning a normal-layer input to Hypershift returns two mappings for the same input: Hypershift in the normal layer and Hypershift in its secondary layer.
logical_mapping_facts.mapping_helper: Main module 9267 exports rq as helper ie (export near character offset 4120647, helper near 4124397). It retains inputID and inputType and sets outputType and isHyperShift from its arguments.
logical_mapping_facts.group_identity: Main module 9937 exports ddG for hyperShiftGroup (string declaration near character offset 4179852).
logical_mapping_facts.secondary_editor: Main assignMappingGroup near character offset 4773371 disables a Hypershift-group input when displaying the secondary layer.
logical_mapping_facts.leave: Replacing an existing normal Hypershift mapping with another action removes the same-input secondary mapping. Choosing default removes the selected-layer override and the same-input Hypershift-group override. The secondary then uses its default fallback; the editor does not restore the pre-Hypershift custom mapping.
logical_mapping_facts.warning: The official frontend warns that assigning Hypershift disables that input's secondary function.
logical_mapping_facts.primary_click_policy: The official ordinary-mouse left-click guard examines normal mappings, separately from secondary mappings (main updateMappingsToButtons near character offset 4770769).

wire_evidence_and_limits.B6_native_record: Existing static inspection of official RzCtl_00B6.dll setter 0x1002E2D0 and getter 0x1002A510 proves the ten-byte profile/input/layer plus seven-byte action record for 02/0C and 02/8C. The setter copies the layer selector and action bytes independently.
wire_evidence_and_limits.Hypershift_action_reference: geezmolycos/razerqdhid commit 4363a8836ab970c712fa8f2a9dd530a7e7bc5011, docs/cmd_button-en.md, describes this action for a Basilisk protocol reference.
wire_evidence_and_limits.translation_caveat: The exact DeathAdder frontend's logical pair is primary-source evidence. Composing that pair with the B6 record transport and the cross-model Fn12 action is reconstructed wire behavior. This inspection did not establish a DeathAdder-native HyperShiftGroup-to-Fn12 converter or physically observe press/release behavior.
wire_evidence_and_limits.simulation_caveat: A memory transport that stores independent layer records proves codec/readback and recovery behavior. It does not prove how firmware resolves a held modifier or its release. Default records generated by the production codec are synthetic fixtures, not independent hardware GET captures.

implementation_requirements: Read and recognize both original records before either paired setter; retain unknown originals.
Apply and independently verify the same-input normal and secondary records as one logical operation, without uncertain setter resends.
Prevent independent editing of the secondary record while its normal input acts as Hypershift.
On exit, reset the paired secondary to its default only after verifying the relevant original/owned Hypershift state; retain foreign changes.
Recover only values still owned by the failed attempt, preserve layer identity, and retain an ordinary normal-layer left click.
